source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: Which country makes the best jollof rice? D.C. foodies put it to a blind test
articles.summary: 西非名菜 jollof rice（番茄香料米饭）到底哪国最正宗？一场在华盛顿举办的"盲测节"让两千名食客用舌头投票，也带出了一段跨越国界的美食 rivalry。

sentences.en: It's a heated historic rivalry across West Africa: Which country makes the best jollof rice?
sentences.zh: 这是西非一场激烈的历史性较量：究竟哪个国家做的 jollof rice 最正宗？

sentences.en: Cooks across both Nigeria and Ghana have long claimed to make the best.
sentences.zh: 尼日利亚和加纳的厨师们长久以来都宣称自己做得最好。

sentences.en: But chefs in Senegal argue that it originated there in the 14th century — so it must be the best!
sentences.zh: 但塞内加尔的厨师辩称，这道菜 14 世纪就发源于他们那里——所以它必定是最棒的！

sentences.en: No fewer than 10 countries offer their own version of the dish: a rich, fragrant rice cooked down with spices, tomatoes and meat.
sentences.zh: 不少于 10 个国家都有自己版本的这道菜：用香料、番茄和肉慢炖而成的浓香米饭。

sentences.en: On Saturday, 2,000 people stood in line near Washington, D.C.'s Union Market for a yellow box of six color-coded taster cups.
sentences.zh: 周六，两千人在华盛顿特区联合市场附近排起长队，只为领取一盒六杯、按颜色编码的试吃杯。

sentences.en: The organizers of the Jollof Festival have traveled across the United States to put this debate to the test.
sentences.zh: Jollof 美食节的组织者走遍美国，就是要让这场争论接受真正的检验。

sentences.en: They gathered thousands of people for blind tastings of regional jollof prepared by local chefs.
sentences.zh: 他们聚集了数千人，对当地厨师烹制的各地 jollof 进行盲测品鉴。

sentences.en: Friends Julie Agbasi and Shakesha Coleman came out to sample the variety and compared notes as they tried each one.
sentences.zh: 朋友朱莉·阿格巴西和谢基莎·科尔曼前来品尝不同风味，边尝边交流心得。

sentences.en: "It bites you at the end!" Agbasi said after trying one.
sentences.zh: "它最后会辣到你！"阿格巴西尝了一口后说。

sentences.en: My heritage is Nigerian, so we used to eat jollof rice almost all the time, Agbasi said.
sentences.zh: 阿格巴西说：我的血统是尼日利亚人，所以我们以前几乎顿顿都吃 jollof rice。

sentences.en: The rice samples ranged from a bright red to a brighter yellow jollof, flecked with herbs.
sentences.zh: 米饭样品从亮红色到更鲜亮的黄色不等，上面还点缀着香草。

sentences.en: Many visitors enjoyed the samples, but doubled down on their preferences for the jollof of their spouses, neighbors or childhoods.
sentences.zh: 许多游客享受了试吃，却更加坚持自己对配偶、邻居或童年记忆中那碗 jollof 的偏好。

grammar: 现在完成时 have claimed：例 "Cooks across both Nigeria and Ghana have long claimed to make the best." have claimed 表示动作从过去持续到现在，强调长期以来的说法。
破折号引出结论：例 "But chefs in Senegal argue that it originated there in the 14th century — so it must be the best!" 破折号后接 so 引导的结论句。
No fewer than + 数字 表"不少于、多达"：例 "No fewer than 10 countries offer their own version of the dish." 用该结构强调数量之多。
过去分词短语作后置定语：例 "The rice samples ranged from a bright red to a brighter yellow jollof, flecked with herbs." flecked with herbs 修饰 jollof，相当于 which were flecked with herbs。
并列连词 but 表转折：例 "Many visitors enjoyed the samples, but doubled down on their preferences..." but 连接两个相对的动作。
as 引导的时间状语从句：例 "...compared notes as they tried each one." as 表示"当……的时候"。

articles.title: D.C.'s IndyCar race will zoom past museums. Some worry it could harm the art inside
articles.summary: 为庆祝建国里程碑，华盛顿国家广场将首办印地赛车大奖赛，高速赛车从多家博物馆旁呼啸而过，艺术专家担心震动会伤及馆内藏品，主办方则坚称已做好防护。

sentences.en: More than two dozen IndyCar drivers will race 147 laps around Washington, D.C.'s National Mall this weekend for the Freedom 250 Grand Prix.
sentences.zh: 本周末，二十多名印地赛车手将在华盛顿国家广场绕行 147 圈，角逐"自由 250 大奖赛"。

sentences.en: The two-day event includes practices, qualifiers and warmups, culminating in the 250-mile race on Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 这场为期两天的活动包括练习、资格赛和热身，最终在周日下午迎来 250 英里的正赛。

sentences.en: Cars will fly — at speeds up to 180 mph — around a 1.7-mile irregularly-shaped track smack-dab on the National Mall.
sentences.zh: 赛车将以高达每小时 180 英里的速度，在国家广场正中一条 1.7 英里、形状不规则的赛道上飞驰。

sentences.en: Along the route, they will zoom past cultural institutions including the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums.
sentences.zh: 沿途，它们将从国家艺术馆和三家史密森尼博物馆等文化机构旁呼啸而过。

sentences.en: And that has raised questions about the safety of the art and artifacts inside.
sentences.zh: 这也引发了人们对馆内艺术品和文物安全性的质疑。

sentences.en: Namely: Could they be damaged by vibrations from the cars whizzing by?
sentences.zh: 具体而言：飞驰而过的赛车产生的震动，会不会损坏它们？

sentences.en: The National Gallery of Art, whose sculpture garden is along the course, has boarded up some of its outdoor works.
sentences.zh: 国家艺术馆的雕塑花园就在赛道旁，它已用木板封起了部分户外作品。

sentences.en: Spokesperson Chris Abanavas told NPR over email that it conducted an extensive vibration study.
sentences.zh: 发言人克里斯·阿巴纳瓦斯通过邮件告诉 NPR，馆方开展了一项广泛的震动研究。

sentences.en: Race organizers say they are taking proper precautions and don't anticipate any damage.
sentences.zh: 赛事组织方表示，他们正在采取恰当的预防措施，预计不会造成任何损坏。

sentences.en: IndyCar officials point to the success of other races in sensitive areas, like one in Detroit's historic Belle Isle Park.
sentences.zh: 印地赛车官员列举了其他在敏感区域办赛的成功案例，比如底特律历史悠久的贝尔岛公园。

sentences.en: But critics say the National Mall is different: Speed limits are generally around 25 mph.
sentences.zh: 但批评者指出国家广场情况不同：那里的限速通常约为每小时 25 英里。

sentences.en: A race like this has never been held there before, and organizers had less than a year to plan the event.
sentences.zh: 此类赛事此前从未在此举办过，而组织者的筹备时间还不到一年。

grammar: 一般将来时 will + 动词原形：例 "More than two dozen IndyCar drivers will race 147 laps..." 表示按计划即将发生的动作。
现在分词 whizzing by 作后置定语：例 "Could they be damaged by vibrations from the cars whizzing by?" whizzing by 修饰 cars，相当于 which are whizzing by。
whose 引导的非限制性定语从句：例 "The National Gallery of Art, whose sculpture garden is along the course, has boarded up some of its outdoor works." whose 表示所属关系。
破折号插入补充说明：例 "Cars will fly — at speeds up to 180 mph — around a 1.7-mile track..." 破折号内为插入语，说明速度。
现在完成时 has never been held：例 "A race like this has never been held there before..." 强调从过去到现在从未发生过。
并列连词 but 表转折：例 "But critics say the National Mall is different..." but 引出与前文相反的观点。

articles.title: Why tech companies are buying up tons of rare old books to train their AI models
articles.summary: 为给 AI 模型寻找更干净的"人类生成文本"，科技公司大批量收购并扫描市面上难以获取的小众旧书，甚至拆书毁书，引发关于"模型坍缩"与资源浪费的讨论。

sentences.en: Tech companies have been going to great lengths to find ways to train their AI models.
sentences.zh: 科技公司一直不遗余力地寻找训练其 AI 模型的方法。

sentences.en: An investigation by 404 Media traced one purchase of rare books with a tracking device and found that the shipment ended up at an Amazon AI training warehouse.
sentences.zh: 404 Media 的一项调查借助追踪设备追查了一笔稀有书籍采购，发现这批货最终送到了亚马逊的一个 AI 训练仓库。

sentences.en: We've known that AI companies have been doing this since a lawsuit from book authors against Anthropic, which is one of the major AI labs.
sentences.zh: 我们早就知道 AI 公司在这么做，起因是图书作者起诉 Anthropic（一家主要 AI 实验室）的官司。

sentences.en: That lawsuit revealed that they were purchasing books in large quantities, that they were scanning them, and that in order to scan them really fast, they cut the spines off the books.
sentences.zh: 那场官司揭露，他们大量购书、扫描，而且为了扫描得更快，还把书脊裁掉。

sentences.en: When you get an order for hundreds of books that have no coherent theme, that is another sign.
sentences.zh: 当你收到几百本毫无连贯主题的书的订单时，那就是另一个信号。

sentences.en: At the point at which they did that, that content was human-generated.
sentences.zh: 在他们那样做的时候，那些内容还是人类生成的。

sentences.en: It turns out that that causes a problem called model collapse, where if an AI trains on AI training data, it gets worse.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，这会导致一个叫"模型坍缩"的问题——如果 AI 用 AI 生成的数据来训练，效果反而会更差。

sentences.en: So now they're looking for more human-generated text because they already scraped the internet.
sentences.zh: 所以现在他们要寻找更多人类生成的文本，因为互联网早已被他们抓取得一干二净。

sentences.en: The next logical step is to scan books that are not easily available online.
sentences.zh: 合乎逻辑的下一步，就是扫描那些在网上不易获取的书籍。

sentences.en: A rare book is most likely a book that was never printed in large quantities because it is about a niche subject.
sentences.zh: 所谓稀有书，多半是那些因主题小众而从未大量印刷的书。

sentences.en: Amazon confirmed that the warehouse that I reported on was actually used for AI training data.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊确认，我所报道的那个仓库确实被用于 AI 训练数据。

sentences.en: Amazon purchases books through commercial channels to help develop and improve the products and services our customers use.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊通过商业渠道采购书籍，以帮助开发和改进客户使用的产品与服务。

vocab.zh: 崩溃；坍缩（model collapse 模型坍缩）

grammar: 现在完成进行时 have been going / have been doing：例 "Tech companies have been going to great lengths to find ways to train their AI models." 强调动作从过去持续至今。
定语从句 which is one of the major AI labs：例 "...a lawsuit from book authors against Anthropic, which is one of the major AI labs." which 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明 Anthropic。
过去进行时 were purchasing / were scanning：例 "That lawsuit revealed that they were purchasing books in large quantities, that they were scanning them..." 描述过去某时正在进行的动作。
where 引导的定语从句：例 "...a problem called model collapse, where if an AI trains on AI training data, it gets worse." where 修饰 problem，引出一个情景。
原因状语从句 because 引导：例 "So now they're looking for more human-generated text because they already scraped the internet." because 说明原因。
定语从句 that they already scraped：例 "...books that are not easily available online." that 引导定语从句修饰 books。

articles.title: Open AI launches ChatGPT designed for younger users
articles.summary: 面对家长对 AI 影响学习与心理健康的担忧，OpenAI 推出专为 18 岁以下用户设计的"青少年版 ChatGPT"，加强安全防护、加入学习模式，并试图用年龄预测模型识别未成年用户。

sentences.en: Many teenagers use artificial intelligence not just for homework but for companionship.
sentences.zh: 许多青少年使用人工智能，不只是为了写作业，也为了陪伴。

sentences.en: Now OpenAI has a new version of its chatbot that it says addresses some of those concerns and gives parents more control.
sentences.zh: 如今 OpenAI 推出了一款新版聊天机器人，称其解决了部分担忧，并让家长拥有更多掌控权。

sentences.en: It's called ChatGPT for Teens.
sentences.zh: 它叫作"青少年版 ChatGPT"。

sentences.en: ChatGPT for Teens is a dedicated chatbot experience for users under 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 青少年版 ChatGPT 是面向 18 岁以下用户的专属聊天机器人体验。

sentences.en: Users between 17 and 13, which is the youngest age that the platform allows, will be automatically placed into the ChatGPT for Teens experience.
sentences.zh: 13 至 17 岁的用户（平台允许的最小年龄为 13 岁）将自动进入青少年版体验。

sentences.en: When you sign up to create a ChatGPT account, you have to input your full name and age.
sentences.zh: 注册创建 ChatGPT 账号时，你必须填写全名和年龄。

sentences.en: If a kid tries to circumvent that and claims to be older than they are, OpenAI has a second option that they lean on here.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子试图绕过这一步、谎报年龄，OpenAI 还有第二招可以倚仗。

sentences.en: In January, they introduced an age prediction model which helps estimate whether a user is under 18.
sentences.zh: 今年 1 月，他们推出了一个年龄预测模型，可帮助判断用户是否未满 18 岁。

sentences.en: If a child is trying to take a shortcut quickly to get to an answer, ChatGPT for Teens can show them and redirect them to a mode called study mode.
sentences.zh: 如果孩子想走捷径快速得到答案，青少年版会提醒并引导其进入一种叫"学习模式"的状态。

sentences.en: OpenAI says the ChatGPT experience is designed with stronger built-in safety protections.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 表示，该版本内置了更强的安全防护。

sentences.en: It also encourages users to take breaks, with reminders to step away and turn off the chatbot.
sentences.zh: 它还会鼓励用户休息，提醒他们离开屏幕并关掉聊天机器人。

sentences.en: OpenAI also said it includes consistent reminders to tell users that they're talking to AI and not to a person.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 还表示，它会持续提醒用户：你正在和 AI 对话，而不是和人。

grammar: not just...but... 不但……而且：例 "Many teenagers use artificial intelligence not just for homework but for companionship." 连接两个并列成分。
定语从句 that it says addresses...：例 "OpenAI has a new version of its chatbot that it says addresses some of those concerns..." that 引导定语从句修饰 chatbot。
条件状语从句 if 引导：例 "If a kid tries to circumvent that and claims to be older than they are, OpenAI has a second option..." if 表示假设。
比较级 older than：例 "...claims to be older than they are..." than 引出比较对象。
被动语态 is designed：例 "OpenAI says the ChatGPT experience is designed with stronger built-in safety protections." 被动表示"被设计"。
一般过去时 introduced：例 "In January, they introduced an age prediction model..." 描述过去特定时间发生的动作。

articles.title: This high-speed star is whipping around the black hole in the middle of our galaxy
articles.summary: 天文学家发现迄今观测到的最快恒星 S301，它正以每秒逾 1.5 万英里的速度绕银河系中心的超大质量黑洞运行，为研究黑洞如何扭曲时空提供了绝佳"探针"。

sentences.en: In the fall of 2002, scientists calculated the mass of a truly gargantuan entity at the heart of our Milky Way galaxy.
sentences.zh: 2002 年秋天，科学家测算出银河系中心一个真正庞然大物的质量。

sentences.en: It was four million times the mass of our Sun — so big it almost certainly had to be a supermassive black hole.
sentences.zh: 它的质量是太阳的 400 万倍——大到几乎肯定是一个超大质量黑洞。

sentences.en: The object probably looks like Interstellar, says Stefan Gillessen, an astronomer at the Max Planck Institute for Extraterrestrial Physics.
sentences.zh: 马克斯·普朗克地外物理研究所的天文学家斯特凡·吉勒森说，这个天体看起来大概像电影《星际穿越》里的那样。

sentences.en: Black holes are, by their very nature, yawning enigmas — their gravitational pull is so powerful that not even light can escape.
sentences.zh: 就其本质而言，黑洞是令人费解的谜——它们的引力如此之强，连光都无法逃脱。

sentences.en: In new research published in the journal Nature on Wednesday, Gillessen and his colleagues describe the fastest star ever observed.
sentences.zh: 在周三发表于《自然》期刊的新研究中，吉勒森和同事描述了迄今观测到的最快恒星。

sentences.en: Gillessen says that what's important about the discovery isn't the star's speed — but rather its proximity to the black hole.
sentences.zh: 吉勒森说，这项发现的关键不在于恒星的速度——而在于它离黑洞的距离。

sentences.en: Thereby we can use the star as a probe to visualize how gravity is acting on space and time.
sentences.zh: 因此我们可以把恒星当作探针，来直观展现引力如何作用于空间和时间。

sentences.en: Despite their gravitational dominance in the universe, researchers still have rather basic questions about black holes.
sentences.zh: 尽管黑洞在宇宙中占据引力主导，研究人员对它们仍有一些相当基础的问题。

sentences.en: We want to understand how black holes work and how black holes influence their direct environment.
sentences.zh: 我们想弄清楚黑洞如何运作，又如何影响它们周围的直接环境。

sentences.en: And if you want to know about black holes, the center of the Milky Way is the best laboratory we have.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解黑洞，银河系中心就是我们手头最好的实验室。

sentences.en: Gillessen and his team used four of the European Southern Observatory's telescopes in Chile to gather infrared light.
sentences.zh: 吉勒森和团队使用了欧洲南方天文台位于智利的四台望远镜来收集红外光。

sentences.en: He first noticed something curious in the data a few years ago: a very faint star came to our attention, which moved with a very high velocity.
sentences.zh: 几年前他第一次在数据中注意到异常：一颗非常暗淡的恒星引起了我们的注意，它以极高的速度运动。

grammar: 一般过去时 calculated：例 "In the fall of 2002, scientists calculated the mass of a truly gargantuan entity..." 描述过去具体时间发生的动作。
so...that... 结果状语从句：例 "their gravitational pull is so powerful that not even light can escape." so + 形容词 + that 从句表结果。
what 引导主语从句：例 "what's important about the discovery isn't the star's speed — but rather its proximity to the black hole." what 从句整体作主语。
不定式 to visualize 表目的：例 "...we can use the star as a probe to visualize how gravity is acting on space and time." 不定式说明用途。
despite 引导的让步：例 "Despite their gravitational dominance in the universe, researchers still have rather basic questions about black holes." despite + 名词短语表"尽管"。
which 引导非限制性定语从句：例 "...a very faint star came to our attention, which moved with a very high velocity." which 指代前面的 star。

articles.title: Chinese court sentences founder of property developer Evergrande to life in prison
articles.summary: 中国恒大集团创始人许家印被深圳中院判处无期徒刑，公司被罚逾 20 亿美元。这家曾负债超 3000 亿美元的地产巨头因财务造假与非法集资轰然倒塌，成为行业转折的标志性事件。

sentences.en: Chinese property developer Hui Ka Yan, founder of the Evergrande real estate group, has been sentenced to life in prison.
sentences.zh: 中国房地产开发商、恒大集团创始人许家印已被判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: The companies were fined a total of $2.3 billion, a court in the southern city of Shenzhen said Thursday.
sentences.zh: 深圳一家法院周四表示，相关公司共被罚款 23 亿美元。

sentences.en: The decision marks a milestone in Evergrande's saga after it collapsed with more than $300 billion in liabilities.
sentences.zh: 这一判决标志着恒大漫长危机的里程碑——它倒闭时负债超过 3000 亿美元。

sentences.en: Chinese authorities cracked down on excessive borrowing in the real estate industry in 2020.
sentences.zh: 2020 年，中国监管部门对房地产行业过度借贷行为进行了整顿。

sentences.en: That triggered a crunch among many developers and brought on a downturn in the property market.
sentences.zh: 这引发了众多开发商的资金危机，并导致房地产市场下滑。

sentences.en: The Shenzhen Intermediate People's Court convicted Hui and Evergrande of engaged in large-scale financial fraud.
sentences.zh: 深圳市中级法院裁定许家印和恒大犯有大规模金融欺诈。

sentences.en: In a statement, the court also said Hui abused his position in orchestrating financial fraud and misappropriating company assets.
sentences.zh: 法院在声明中还表示，许家印滥用职权，策划金融欺诈并挪用公司资产。

sentences.en: It also sentenced several other senior Evergrande executives to prison terms of up to 18 years.
sentences.zh: 法院还判处恒大其他几名高管最高 18 年有期徒刑。

sentences.en: Hui pleaded guilty in April to various charges including illegal absorption of public deposits, fraud and bribery.
sentences.zh: 今年 4 月，许家印对多项指控认罪，包括非法吸收公共存款、欺诈和贿赂。

sentences.en: China Evergrande, founded in 1996, defaulted on its debts in 2021.
sentences.zh: 成立于 1996 年的中国恒大在 2021 年债务违约。

sentences.en: It was the world's most heavily indebted real estate developer before it was ordered to liquidate its assets.
sentences.zh: 在被下令清算资产之前，它曾是全世界负债最重的房地产开发商。

sentences.en: Authorities said Evergrande had manipulated its financial data by tactics that included prematurely booking revenue from property sales.
sentences.zh: 有关部门表示，恒大通过包括提前确认房产销售收入在内的手段操纵了财务数据。

grammar: 现在完成时被动 has been sentenced：例 "Chinese property developer Hui Ka Yan... has been sentenced to life in prison." 现在完成时被动，强调判决结果对现在的影响。
after 引导的时间状语从句：例 "The decision marks a milestone in Evergrande's saga after it collapsed with more than $300 billion in liabilities." after 引出先发生的动作。
that 引导的定语从句：例 "Authorities said Evergrande had manipulated its financial data by tactics that included prematurely booking revenue..." that 修饰 tactics。
过去完成时 had manipulated：例 "Authorities earlier said their investigations found Evergrande had manipulated its financial data..." 过去完成时表示"过去的过去"。
并列连词 and 连接谓语：例 "That triggered a crunch among many developers and brought on a downturn in the property market." and 连接两个谓语动词。
介词短语 including 表列举：例 "Hui pleaded guilty... to various charges including illegal absorption of public deposits, fraud and bribery." including 引出所包含的内容。

articles.title: Record cyclosporiasis outbreak tests the response of a 'weakened' health system
articles.summary: 美国遭遇史上最大规模的环孢子虫病爆发，逾 1.5 万例确诊，多与受污染的墨西哥生菜有关；地方食品安全人手不足，追踪与控制这种致腹泻寄生虫的难度陡增。

sentences.en: Environmental health expert Bob Custard spent four decades working with local governments on things like clean water, rabies prevention and food safety.
sentences.zh: 环境健康专家鲍勃·卡斯塔德花了四十年与地方政府的净水、狂犬病预防和食品安全等工作打交道。

sentences.en: With the largest-ever cyclosporiasis outbreak concentrated in nearby states, Custard said federal funding cuts have left local food safety programs across the state grossly understaffed.
sentences.zh: 面对史上最大规模的环孢子虫病爆发集中在邻近各州，卡斯塔德说联邦经费削减让全州地方食品安全项目严重人手不足。

sentences.en: Health officials are unable to keep pace with the interviews and investigations needed to track and contain the diarrhea-causing bug.
sentences.zh: 卫生官员跟不上所需的访谈与调查节奏，难以追踪并控制这种导致腹泻的寄生虫。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, epidemiologist Susan Mayne said the government has responded slowly to the record-shattering outbreak that started in May.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，流行病学家苏珊·梅恩表示，政府对这场始于 5 月、打破纪录的爆发反应迟缓。

sentences.en: The summer's cyclosporiasis outbreak has been mostly linked to contaminated iceberg lettuce grown in Mexico.
sentences.zh: 今夏的环孢子虫病爆发主要与墨西哥种植、受到污染的结球生菜有关。

sentences.en: The U.S. now has over 15,700 cases confirmed by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention as of this week.
sentences.zh: 截至本周，美国疾控中心已确诊超过 1.57 万例。

sentences.en: Mayne echoed other scientists and food safety experts who said that is affecting the ground game against Cyclospora.
sentences.zh: 梅恩呼应了其他科学家和食品安全专家的说法，称这正影响对抗环孢子虫的"地面战"。

sentences.en: I think that that has really pushed us into a new level of vulnerability in terms of our food safety system, Mayne said.
sentences.zh: 梅恩说：我认为这真的把我们的食品安全体系推到了一个新的脆弱境地。

sentences.en: Most of the states' food safety and outbreak programs are funded by grants from the FDA and CDC.
sentences.zh: 大多数州的食品安全与疫情应对项目都由 FDA 和 CDC 的拨款资助。

sentences.en: Kentucky's Cabinet for Health and Family Services said its food safety staff is down 30 to 50%.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州卫生与家庭服务部表示，其食品安全人员减少了 30% 到 50%。

sentences.en: Michigan, with the highest caseload, successfully fought grant cuts in court.
sentences.zh: 病例数最高的密歇根州成功在法庭上阻止了拨款削减。

sentences.en: That allows disease surveillance, investigation, reporting and public service messaging to continue for now.
sentences.zh: 这让疾病监测、调查、上报和公共服务宣传得以暂时继续。

vocab.zh: 环孢子虫病（一种食源性寄生虫病）

grammar: 现在完成时 have left：例 "federal funding cuts have left local food safety programs across the state grossly understaffed." 现在完成时表示过去动作对现在的影响。
过去分词 contaminated 作后置定语：例 "The summer's cyclosporiasis outbreak has been mostly linked to contaminated iceberg lettuce..." contaminated 修饰 lettuce，相当于 which was contaminated。
定语从句 needed to track and contain：例 "Health officials are unable to keep pace with the interviews and investigations needed to track and contain the diarrhea-causing bug." needed 短语修饰前面的名词。
as of 表示"截至"：例 "The U.S. now has over 15,700 cases confirmed by the CDC as of this week." as of 后接时间节点。
现在完成时被动 has been linked：例 "The summer's cyclosporiasis outbreak has been mostly linked to contaminated iceberg lettuce..." 现在完成时被动。
who 引导的定语从句：例 "Mayne echoed other scientists and food safety experts who said that is affecting the ground game..." who 修饰 experts。

articles.title: Prince Harry and Meghan are returning to the U.K. with their children
articles.summary: 哈里王子和梅根决定从今年秋天起长居英国，两个孩子已在英入学，但二人不会恢复王室"在职成员"身份；此行被外界视为哈里与父亲查尔斯三世缓和关系的信号。

sentences.en: Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, have decided to return to the United Kingdom for an extended stay starting this fall.
sentences.zh: 哈里王子和妻子梅根已决定从今年秋天起返回英国，进行一段较长时间的居留。

sentences.en: They won't resume their roles as working members of the royal family.
sentences.zh: 他们不会恢复作为王室"在职成员"的角色。

sentences.en: The couple's children, Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, have already enrolled at British schools and will start classes in September.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的孩子——7 岁的阿奇王子和 5 岁的莉莉贝特公主——已在英国学校注册，将于 9 月开学。

sentences.en: The family plans to live at a private, non-royal residence outside of London.
sentences.zh: 这家人计划住在伦敦郊外一处私人的、非王室的住所。

sentences.en: Harry and Meghan gave up their royal duties and moved to California more than six years ago.
sentences.zh: 哈里和梅根在六年多前放弃了王室职责，搬到了加利福尼亚。

sentences.en: Although relations with the rest of the royal family have soured since then, Harry has recently expressed an interest in reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 尽管自那以后与王室其他成员的关系已经恶化，哈里最近表达了和解的意愿。

sentences.en: Harry has recently expressed an interest in reconciliation so he could spend more time with his father, King Charles III.
sentences.zh: 哈里最近表达了和解的意愿，以便能多陪陪父亲查尔斯三世国王。

sentences.en: Charles was informed of the couple's plans on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯在周日得知了这对夫妇的计划。

sentences.en: According to a source close to the Sussexes, Meghan will continue heading her As Ever company from the U.K.
sentences.zh: 据一位接近苏塞克斯夫妇的消息人士称，梅根将在英国继续执掌她的 As Ever 公司。

sentences.en: Harry and Meghan have had a stormy relationship with the royal family ever since they decamped to a mansion in Montecito.
sentences.zh: 自从他们搬进蒙特西托的豪宅，哈里和梅根与王室的关系就一直风波不断。

sentences.en: In Harry's memoir 'Spare,' the couple said they left Britain to escape the restrictions of royal life and criticized palace officials for being insensitive to Meghan's mental health.
sentences.zh: 在哈里的回忆录《备胎》中，二人表示离开英国是为了逃避王室生活的束缚，并批评王室官员对梅根的心理健康漠不关心。

sentences.en: Harry has also been embroiled in a legal wrangle with the British government after a government committee refused to authorize police protection.
sentences.zh: 在一个政府委员会拒绝批准警方保护后，哈里还卷入了与英国政府的法律纠纷。

grammar: 现在完成时 have decided：例 "Prince Harry and his wife, Meghan, have decided to return to the United Kingdom..." 现在完成时表示已做出的决定及其影响。
although 引导让步状语从句：例 "Although relations with the rest of the royal family have soured since then, Harry has recently expressed an interest in reconciliation." although 表示"尽管"。
现在完成时 have had：例 "Harry and Meghan have had a stormy relationship with the royal family..." 强调从过去持续到现在的状态。
so 引导目的状语：例 "Harry has recently expressed an interest in reconciliation so he could spend more time with his father..." so 引出目的。
after 引导时间状语从句：例 "Harry has also been embroiled in a legal wrangle... after a government committee refused to authorize police protection." after 表示"在……之后"。
ever since 引导时间从句：例 "...ever since they decamped to a mansion in Montecito." ever since 表示"自从……以来"。
